- Initial release of jishudb-search skill for querying existing JishuDB knowledge bases and internal documents.
- Supports listing knowledge bases and their files, reading document content, and checking job/import status.
- Answers are always based on actual search results with cited sources—no fabricated or inferred information.
- Requires authorized connection to JishuDB and the appropriate environment configuration.
- Provides a Bash script (kb-search.sh) for HTTP API-based searching, supporting listing, searching, and document reading operations.
- Includes detailed usage guidance and error handling instructions in both Chinese and English.
